chunks: Ḥammād narrated to us from ʿAbd al-Aʿlā, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) about the saying of the general Muslims: that the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) said, “Whoever dies while he has no Imam dies a death of Jāhiliyyah.” So he said: “It is true, by Allah.” I said: “If an Imam dies and a man in Khurāsān does not know who his successor is, does that excuse him?” He said: “It does not excuse him. When the Imam dies, the proof of his successor falls upon those who are with him in the town, and the duty of setting out belongs to those who are not in his presence when the news reaches them.”

Surely Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: “So why should not a group from every party among them go forth, that they may gain understanding in the religion and warn their people when they return to them, so that they may beware?”
I said: “If a group sets out and some of them die before arriving and coming to know?” He said: “Allah, Majestic and Mighty, says:”
“And whoever goes forth from his house emigrating to Allah and His Messenger, then death overtakes him, his reward has indeed fallen upon Allah.”

I said: “If some of them reach the town and find your door closed to you and your curtain let down, while you do not call them to yourself, and there is no one to direct them to you, then by what would they recognize that?” He said: “By the revealed Book of Allah.” I said: “How does Allah, Mighty and Majestic, say it?” He said: “I see that you have spoken about this before today.” I said: “Yes.” He said: “Then recall what Allah revealed concerning ʿAlī (عليه السلام), what the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) said to him concerning al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn (عليهما السلام), what Allah singled ʿAlī (عليه السلام) out with, and what the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) said regarding him from his bequest to him and his appointment of him, what would happen to them, the acknowledgment of al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn of that, his bequest to al-Ḥasan, and al-Ḥusayn’s submission to him by the word of Allah:”
“The Prophet has a greater claim over the believers than their own selves, and his wives are their mothers; and those of kinship, some of them have a greater claim over others in the Book of Allah.”

I said: “The people have spoken regarding Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), and they say: how did it pass over, among the sons of his father, one who had kinship like his and one who was older than him, and come short of one younger than him?” He said: “The possessor of this matter is recognized by three qualities not found in anyone else: he is the worthiest of people in relation to the one before him, he is his successor, and with him are the weapons of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) and his bequest. That is with me, and I am not disputed regarding it.” I said: “That is concealed out of fear of the ruler.” He said: “It is never in concealment except that it has an evident proof. My father entrusted to me what was there, and when death came to him he said: ‘Call witnesses for me.’ So I called four men from Quraysh, among them Nāfiʿ, the mawlā of ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar. He said: ‘Write: this is what Yaʿqūb bequeathed to his sons:”
“O my sons, surely Allah has chosen for you the religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims.”

I said: “And Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī bequeathed to his son Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, and ordered him to shroud him in his cloak in which he used to perform the Friday salat, to wrap him with his turban, to make his grave squared and raise it four fingers, then leave it.” So he said: “Fold it up.” Then he said to the witnesses: “Depart, may Allah have mercy on you.” I said after they had departed: “What was there in this, O my father, that you had witnesses to it?” He said: “I disliked that you should be overpowered and that it should be said, ‘He did not leave a bequest,’ so I wanted there to be a proof for you. Thus, when a man comes to a town and says, ‘Who is the successor of so-and-so?’ it is said, ‘So-and-so.’” I said: “If he associates another in the bequest?” He said: “Ask him, for he will clarify it for you.”

key_terms.إِمَامٌ: the divinely appointed Imam whose recognition is obligatory
key_terms.النَّفْرِ: setting out or traveling in order to seek religious knowledge
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةِ: the bequest or testament indicating transfer of authority
key_terms.بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ الْمُنْزَلِ: through the revealed Book of Allah as a means of recognition
key_terms.حُجَّةُ: the binding divine proof or authoritative evidence
key_terms.سِلَاحُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم weapon as a sign of rightful succession
key_terms.مِيتَةً جَاهِلِيَّةً: a death resembling the state of pre-Islamic ignorance

ai.seo_question: How is the true Imam recognized after the death of the previous Imam according to al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the necessity of recognizing the Imam and explains that ignorance of the Imam after the death of the previous Imam is not an acceptable excuse once the means of knowing are available. It describes that the Imam is known through divine proof, prior designation, and inherited signs such as the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم weapon and bequest, while also citing Qur’anic verses about seeking religious understanding and lawful succession.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman who said, ‘Hammad narrated to us from Abdul A’ala who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the words of the general Muslims that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who dies and there isn’t an Imam<sup>asws</sup> for him dies the death of ignorance (Pre-Islamic period)’’. 
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The truth, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!’ I said, ‘So if an Imam<sup>asws</sup> was to pass away and a man is at Khurasan not knowing who his<sup>asws</sup> successor<sup>asws</sup> is, that would not be a leeway for him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no leeway if the Imam<sup>asws</sup>, when he<sup>asws</sup> passes away, (Seeking) the Divine Authority<sup>asws</sup> of his<sup>asws</sup> successor<sup>asws</sup>, falls upon the ones who are with him<sup>asws</sup> in the city, and right of the number (of persons) upon the ones who are not in his<sup>asws</sup> presence, when there reaches to them (the news).

Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [9:122] And it was not for the believers that they should go forth all together; why should not then a company from every party from among them go forth that they may apply themselves to obtain understanding in religion, and that they may warn their people when they come back to them that they may be cautious?’.
I said, ‘the number of people (who go out), supposing some of them die before they arrive, so they would know?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is Saying

[4:100] And whoever emigrates in Allah's Way, he will find in the earth many a place of refuge and abundant resources, and whoever goes forth from his house fleeing to Allah and His Rasool, and then death overtakes him, his Recompense is indeed with Allah’.

I said, ‘Supposing some of them reach the city and they find you<sup>asws</sup> such that the door is locked upon you<sup>asws</sup> and your<sup>asws</sup> curain is drawn upon you<sup>asws</sup>, (and) you<sup>asws</sup> are not calling them to yourself<sup>asws</sup> nor does there happen to be someone who can point them to you<sup>asws</sup>. So with what would they be recognising that?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘By the Revealed Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
I said, ‘So how is Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Majestic and Mighty Saying (it)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> see you have spoken regarding this before today’. I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Recall what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Revealed regarding Ali<sup>asws</sup> and what Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said for him<sup>asws</sup> regarding Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and What Allah<sup>azwj</sup> specialised Ali<sup>asws</sup> with and what Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said regarding him<sup>asws</sup> from his<sup>saww</sup> bequest to him<sup>asws</sup>, and appointing him<sup>asws</sup>, and what would be hitting them, and the acknowledgment of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> with that, and his<sup>saww</sup> bequest to Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and the submission of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> to him<sup>asws</sup> by the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>
[33:6] The Prophet is closer to the Believers than their own selves, and his wives are their mothers; and the possessors of relationships some of them are closer to others in the Book of Allah’.

I said, ‘But the people are speaking regarding Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and they are saying, ‘How come it (Imamate) exceeded from the son of his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, the one who had similar relationship like his<sup>asws</sup>, and the one who was older than him<sup>asws</sup>, and was curtailed from the one who was younger than him<sup>asws</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Master<sup>asws</sup> of this command is recognised by three characteristics which do not happen to be in others than him<sup>asws</sup> – He<sup>asws</sup> would be the closest of the people with the one<sup>asws</sup> who was before him<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> would be his<sup>asws</sup> successor<sup>asws</sup>, and with him<sup>asws</sup> would be the weapons of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> bequest, and (all) that is with me<sup>asws</sup>, there is no disputing with regards to it’.
I said, ‘That is concealed out of fearing of the ruling authorities?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘These do not happen to be in concealment except for it is an apparent proof that my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> entrusted me<sup>asws</sup> with whatever was there. So when the death presented itself, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Call some witnesses for me’. So I called over four from Qureysh, among them being Nafau, a slave of Abdullah Bin Umar. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Write this, what Yaqoub<sup>saww</sup> bequeathed to his<sup>as</sup> sons:
[2:132] O my sons! Surely Allah has Chosen for you the Religion, therefore die not unless you are Muslims (submitters).

I<sup>asws</sup> say: ‘And Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> bequeaths to his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> and instructs him<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> should enshroud him<sup>asws</sup> in his<sup>asws</sup> cloak which he<sup>asws</sup> used to pray the Friday Salat in, and that he<sup>asws</sup> turban him<sup>asws</sup> with his<sup>asws</sup> turban, and that he<sup>asws</sup> should square his<sup>asws</sup> grave and raise it (to) four fingers. Then he<sup>asws</sup> should isolate from him<sup>asws</sup>’. 
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then he<sup>asws</sup> folded it, then said to the witnesses: ‘Leave, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be Merciful to you all!’ So I<sup>asws</sup> said after they had left: ‘What was in this, O father<sup>asws</sup>, that you<sup>asws</sup> had it witnessed upon?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> disliked it that you<sup>asws</sup> be overcome and it should be said that he<sup>asws</sup> did not bequeath, therefore I<sup>asws</sup> wanted that there should happen to be a proof for you<sup>asws</sup>. Thus it is such, when the man proceeds to the city (and) he says, ‘Who did so and so bequeath to?’ It would be said, ‘So and so’’. 
I said, ‘Supposing there is an associate in the bequest?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You can ask him<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> would explain it to you all’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman who has said that narrated to us Hammad from ‘Abd al-A‘la’ who has said the following.

“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the statement of Sunni Muslims (al-‘Amma) that says the Messenger of Allah has said, “If a person would die without having an Imam his death would be as if he has died as the death of ignorance (pre-Islamic age of darkness)” The Imam (a.s.) said, “ That is very true, by Allah.” I then asked, “what if the Imam would pass away and a person is in Khurasan and does not know who the executor of the will of the Imam (a.s.) is, is this good excuse for him?” He (the Imam (a.s.) said, “No, that is not a good reason. When the Imam leaves this world the authority of the executor nof his applies to those would live in the area. Also the obligation search and learn about one’s duties apply to those who are not in area but who learned about the passing away of the Imam.

Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Gracious, has said, “Not all believers have to become specialists in religious learning. Why do not some people from each group of believers seek to become specialists in religious learning and, after completing their studies, guide their group so that they will have fear of God.” [9:122]
I then said, “What if they did went out to find out but some of them would die before they could find out?” He said, “Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Gracious, has said, “
. . and one who dies, after having abandoned his home to get near to God and His Messenger, will receive his reward from God. . .” [4:100]

I if some of them would reach your town but would find out that you have closed your door and the curtains are drawn closed. You would not call them to yourself and there is no one to guide them to you. How then the will know about you?” He said, “They would know about me through the book that Allah has revealed.” I then asked, “How Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Gracious, has said it?” He said, “I know that you have spoken to me about before this day also.” I said, “That is right.” He then said, “Recall what Allah has said about Ali (a.s) and what the Messenger of Allah said to him about Hassan and Husayn and What Allah has specially said about Ali (a.s) and what the Messenger of Allah has said about him about his will to him and hid appointing him and their sufferings and the acknowledgements of al-Hassan and al-Husayn of such facts. Recall the will of al-Hassan and his delivering it to al-Husayn.
Allah has said, “The Prophet has more authority over the believers than themselves. His wives are their mothers. The relatives are closer to each other, according to the Book of God, .” .[33:6]

I then said, “People speak about abu Ja‘far‘far (a.s) and say, “How is it that Imamat (leadership with Divine authority has stepped out for him from among all the sons of his father even though they are all relatives and older than him and those younger than him did receive it just because they were younger?” He said, “The one would possess this matter (Leadership with Divine Authority) can be recognized through three evidence that are not found with other people. He must have greater priority to the preceding Imam and that he would be the executor of the will of the preceding Imam. With him there must be the Armaments of the Messenger of Allah and the document of his will. This document is with me and no one disputes it.” I then asked, “Is that kept secret and hidden for fear from the rulers?” He said, “There is nothing secret and hidden for which there is no clear evidence available. What is there my father entrusted to me. When he wasw about to leave this world he asked me to call people to bear testimony for him. I then called four people from Quraysh among them was Nafi‘ salve of ‘Abdallah ibn ‘Umar. My father said, “Write down, ‘This is how the will of Jacob to his children reads,
“God has chosen this religion for you. You must not leave this world unless you are a Muslim (submitted to the will of the Lord of the Universe).” [2:132]

Muhammad ibn Ali made the same kind of will to his son, Ja‘far ibn Muhammad annd commanded him to shroud him in his own gown which he would use during his Friday prayers. That his own turban must be used for him, that the surface of his grave should be given a square shape, raised three inches from the ground and thereafter leave it that much only. Thereafter he wrpped up the document of the will and asked the witnesses to leave saying, “May Allah grant you blessings. When they left I asked, “What was in it O father, that asked them to bear testimony to?” He said, “I did not like that you will be defeated and people will say, ‘He left this world without a will. I wanted it to be a supporting authority for you. This the fact that help one who comes to the town and asks, “To who did so and so made a will? And it is said to him, “The will was made to so and so.” I then asked, “What he (Imam) would partners in the will?” He said, “You must ask him. He will explain it to you.”
